## SK Hynix's Solidigm unit weighing U.S. NAND flash factory; SK Hynix stock jumps

A U.S.-based NAND fab via Solidigm would be a major reshoring move qualifying for CHIPS Act support, improving 000660.KS's geopolitical positioning; it also signals a supply build in NAND that could pressure pricing if demand does not keep pace.

- SK Hynix's Solidigm subsidiary is reportedly weighing construction of a U.S. NAND flash factory, per sources cited across three outlets (Finimize, Economic Times, TipRanks).
- SK Hynix (000660.KS) shares rose on the news.
- This Solidigm NAND factory consideration is a separate development from the denied Intel JV — it involves NAND specifically rather than a broad memory partnership.
- Multi-outlet sourcing increases credibility of the report, though no final decision has been announced.
